description_html:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

ElevenAgents is our platform for building and running conversational AI agents at scale. As our first Application Security Engineer embedded in the Agents team, you’ll make the secure way the easy way. You’ll build the security tooling and reusable primitives that let engineers ship securely by default.

This is a builder role. Expect to spend about 70% of your time building tools and internal systems, and the rest working with engineers, staying in sync with Core Security, and doing security research. More than half of the work is greenfield and most of it starts with you, you’ll spot the problems worth solving and own each solution from idea to production.

You will:

 - Build security primitives that are easy for engineers to adopt, starting from what you find when you audit the Agents codebase

 - Review new product work for security and feed what you learn back into shared tooling

 - Lead the major security improvements to the Agents platform, working closely with Core Security

 - Make sure Agents platform uses authn and authz controls correctly and building the guardrails that keep the platform from compromising on security best practices

 - Set the security bar for the Agents platform and make meeting it the easy path for product engineers

 - Work with engineers daily to help them ship fast and safely




REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years in application security engineering at scale, covering secure design, vulnerability management and security tooling

 - Strong software engineering skills: you have built and shipped products end to end, in production-quality code

 - Fluency in Python, our main language. Golang or another language is fine if you can pick up Python quickly

 - Hands-on experience with authentication and authorization. Experience securing cross-service communication is a bonus

 - Experience with large-scale, customer-facing backend systems and enterprise-grade security

 - Clear communication and a real enjoyment of working with developers

 - A track record of owning delivery end to end

Bonus:

 - Security for AI and LLM applications

 - Cloud-native experience (AWS or GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, IAM, networking, Linux internals)

 - Experience in regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI, HIPAA)

 - Not required: Compliance certifications, incident response experience, a traditional security background, or prior domain knowledge. We care about what you have built and shipped, and open source work or conference talks are welcome evidence of that.




LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. However, to facilitate working with the Security Team, we prefer candidates based in GMT to GMT+3 or UK. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London or Warsaw

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

description_html: Your work days are brighter here.     We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.           About the Team  Workday is strategically expanding into the identity management space to govern access for both employees and AI agents across the enterprise. As enterprise adoption of autonomous agents accelerates, CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs are facing a critical governance challenge: how to manage identity, access, provisioning, lifecycle automation, and least-privilege controls across a combined workforce of people and AI agents.  Workday is establishing a specialized Identity team focused on helping enterprise customers modernize identity governance and access management for this new era of work. As a member of our diverse and skilled Identity presales team, you will have the opportunity to communicate and demonstrate the power of Workday's identity governance capabilities, expected to become part of Workday's Agent System of Record, to prospects and customers. This team sits at the exciting intersection of Sales, Product Management, Consulting Services, Marketing, and Value Management, giving you exposure to all areas of the business while helping customers reduce access risk, strengthen compliance, automate identity lifecycle processes, and unlock trusted AI adoption at scale.  The Revenue organization at Workday is grounded in integrity, innovation, accountability, and collaboration. We are looking for experienced solution architects who can build trusted executive relationships, shape complex security and identity focused sales cycles, and help accelerate market adoption in a strategic growth area for Workday.    About the Role      In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to Workday customers and prospects, crafting the overall identity governance and access management solution strategy to achieve their business objectives. With expertise in identity and security domains and a strong understanding of enterprise SaaS solutions, you will establish yourself as a leader with a valued point of view on how organizations should govern access for both human workers and AI agents.     You are comfortable engaging CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, senior technology leaders, security executives, and ecosystem partners, translating complex identity governance, provisioning, access review, least-privilege, lifecycle automation, compliance, and AI governance requirements into clear, compelling solution strategies and executive-level value propositions.      What you’ll do:       Serve as a trusted advisor to prospects and customers on identity governance, authentication, authorization, and access control strategies.    Architect and deliver technical solutions spanning IGA, IAM, CIEM, and PAM, mapping business requirements into scalable identity architectures.    Lead workshops, whiteboard sessions, and demos that showcase the business value of identity automation, access governance, and zero trust.    Design and implement integration strategies across AWS, GCP, and Azure, with a strong understanding of native identity services, policies, and entitlement models.    Nerd out on protocols and standards like SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM, and FIDO2 — and explain them to both engineers and CISOs.    Build, test, and troubleshoot custom integrations and workflows using APIs, SDKs, and Terraform/automation frameworks.    Stay ahead of industry trends (IGA, CIEM, Just-in-Time access, Zero Trust, identity for machine/non-human accounts) and share thought leadership with internal teams and customers.           #identityjobs        About You      We are seeking people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, working directly with customers to understand their needs, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance our platform. If you're passionate about identity security, automation, and making access management seamless for enterprises, we'd love to hear from you.      Basic Qualifications      Enterprise Architect, Identity   ·  4+ years in a technical pre-sales, solutions engineering, or identity architect/engineer role, OR equivalent hands-on experience in IAM/IGA/AI. ·  1+ years focused on identity governance, identity and access management, cybersecurity, cloud security, or related solutions.   Senior Enterprise Architect, Identity  ·   6+ years in a technical pre-sales, solutions engineering, or identity architect/engineer role, OR equivalent hands-on experience in IAM/IGA/AI. ·   3+ years focused on identity governance, identity and access management, cybersecurity, cloud security, or related solutions.   Principal Enterprise Architect, Identity  ·  8+ years in a technical pre-sales, solutions engineering, or identity architect/engineer role, OR equivalent hands-on experience in IAM/IGA/AI. ·  5+ years focused on identity governance, identity and access management, cybersecurity, cloud security, or related solutions.     Other Qualifications      Foundational understanding of authentication, authorization, identity services (Okta, Entra AD, LDAP, Google Workspace), and cloud IAM basics.    Practical knowledge of directory services (Okta, Entra ID, LDAP, Google Workspace, on-prem AD).    Hands-on cloud experience with AWS IAM/IAM Identity Center, GCP IAM, and Azure AD/role-based access models, including how to govern them with IGA.    Comfort with GO, APIs, SDKs, JSON/YAML, scripting, and automation, Terraform or similar IaC tools.    Great communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.    Curiosity about identity security and drive to deepen technical knowledge over time.    Willingness to travel for customer meetings, partner events, or industry conferences.    Industry-recognized certifications (CCSP, CISSP, AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.)    You enjoy building new things and presenting new ideas.    You love helping customers understand and solve their access management challenges.       Travel is a required element of this role. The position requires up to 25% travel monthly        VISA Sponsorship   is not  available for this role  .     Workday Pay Transparency Statement     The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below.  Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please    click here   .     Primary Location: USA.CA.Pleasanton        Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $115,500 USD - $173,300 USD   Additional Considerations:       If performed in Colorado, the pay range for this job is $115,500 USD - $173,300 USD based on min and max pay range for that role if performed in CO.             The application deadline for this role is the same as the posting end date stated as below:           12/31/2026    Our Approach to Flexible Work      With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply   spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field   with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.        Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance law, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.      Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.     Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.      Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.      If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email     accommodations@workday.com    , as far in advance as possible.        Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!    At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security.  Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.       Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.      In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Program & Project Management    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.         Job Description: Senior Technical Program Manager - Digital Enterprise Technology (DET) Location: Dallas, TX or Indianapolis, IN     What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters   The Senior Technical Program Manager for the DET Sales pillar will be a crucial part of the internal team, providing senior-level leadership and cross-team coordination for large-scale, AI-centric solution deliveries across the Sales space. They will coordinate between multiple solution delivery teams as programs are created, own program timelines and capacity planning, and work with Product Management to ensure scope delivery meets overall program goals and vision according to definitions of success. This role paves the way for critical development and delivery across all dependent teams — defining and clearing blockers, mitigating risk, and ensuring a steady flow of work, while championing new, agentic ways of working across the portfolio.  This role will help shape program management practices across the group. This is an individual contributor role that requires leading large-scale, cross-functional initiatives within our GTM organization, supervising programs from beginning to end to ensure better workflow and more effective communication. They will work closely with executives and key company stakeholders to drive critical programs across the company.   Core Responsibilities & Scope     Work in tandem with product, engineering, architecture, and business stakeholders to identify overall goals, vision, and measures of success for highly complex programs, serving as the primary bridge between product and engineering  Track and manage program artifacts and portfolio hygiene, leading the transition and management of work in Linear, and gleaning actionable insights from the tool to assess and proactively respond to velocity trends  Proactively identify and manage cross-team risks and negotiations with T&P dependencies; escalate and drive resolution of blockers  Apply deep technical understanding of the program's systems and architecture, and develop strong relationships with key program stakeholders  Coordinate project/program interdependencies across the various projects and programs in the portfolio  Drive cross-functional program priorities, including in ambiguous or evolving situations  Lead facilitation of Release Planning / Commitments and other work planning efforts, synthesizing outputs into Linear in partnership Engineering & Product roles  Champion and help embed AI-native/agentic ways of working (e.g., work decomposition, AI-assisted tooling, Rapid Innovation Squads) into program delivery  Coordinate handoffs of program deliverables  Drive program retrospectives upon closure and after completion of critical milestones  Provide program-specific knowledge transfer as new members are added to the program     Minimum Requirements     8+ years experience in a Program/Project Management role; preferably using Agile framework  Strong digital literacy: Experience with G-Suite, ChatGPT, Slack, Linear, or comparable platforms  Demonstrated effective interpersonal skills and strong communication skills (both verbal and written), including with senior/executive stakeholders  Ability to weigh business and technical requirements to help drive desired PI planning outcomes  Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-energy, team-oriented environment  Ability to multi-task and perform effectively under pressure  Experience with business process expertise around enterprise software and internal operations  Bachelor's degree in Business Administration and/or Information Technology or equivalent experience     Preferred Qualifications     Agile, PMP Certification, or MSP Certification  Experience using Salesforce products  Prior experience with Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Slack products  Experience with AI-native/agentic delivery models, or working alongside Agentforce, Data Cloud, or similar AI platform capabilities  Experience supporting GTM, Support, or similar customer-facing technology organizations            Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.      Accommodations    If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this      Accommodations Request Form     .      Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions.
